hero.headline: Professional Websites for SMBs — Built by Our Team, Branded as Yours
hero.description: Thousands of SMBs have no website or an outdated one that hurts credibility, and most don't have the time or skills to build one themselves. Hostopia's white-label DIFM Website Design is a fully managed service you resell under your brand — our team handles consultation, design, copy, QA, and maintenance while you own the customer and the revenue.

features.heading: A Managed Design Service — Without Managing Designers
features.intro: You sell the service. Hostopia's team of designers, copywriters, QA specialists, and website coordinators handles everything from first consultation through ongoing maintenance — all under your brand.

cards.title: Professional Design & Copywriting
cards.body: Industry-aligned themes, high-quality imagery, on-brand colors and fonts, plus professional copywriting that communicates the SMB's value proposition clearly and concisely.

cards.title: Mobile-Responsive & Search-Optimized
cards.body: Every site optimizes automatically across desktop, tablet, and smartphone — with SEO foundations (meta tags, clean URLs, fast load times, proper headings) built in from day one.

cards.title: Flexible Packages & Add-Ons
cards.body: Extra pages, lead forms, interactive galleries, appointment schedulers, coupons, and Online Store setup. Packages scale from basic presence to full digital storefront.

cards.title: Private-Label Project Center
cards.body: SMBs review drafts, approve changes, and collaborate with their Website Coordinator through a branded project portal — all under your name and your experience.

cards.title: Dedicated Website Coordinator
cards.body: A single point of contact manages each project end-to-end, translating customer requests into design execution and keeping timelines on track.

cards.title: Ongoing Maintenance Included
cards.body: Monthly maintenance time keeps sites current — content updates, seasonal changes, and design refreshes handled by the team, not the customer.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Compete with Agencies — Without Building One
partnerAdvantage.intro: DIFM Website Design lets you serve the SMBs who won't use a DIY builder but don't want to find and manage a freelancer or agency on their own. That's a huge, underserved middle of the market.

items.title: Acquire and upgrade customers
items.body: Offer "we build it for you" websites to SMBs who lack the time or skills. Convert non-digital customers into active digital subscribers with a hands-off experience that removes every excuse to delay.

items.title: Bundle into high-value packages
items.body: DIFM pairs with domains, email, hosting, SSL, and marketing services — creating multi-product engagements with higher ARPU, deeper engagement, and stronger retention across the portfolio.

items.title: Scale without creative headcount
items.body: Hostopia's fulfillment team, proprietary delivery platform, and proven QA processes handle volume. You grow revenue without adding designers, project managers, or creative operations.

items.title: Close the gap between builder and custom
items.body: DIFM fills the managed middle — the tier between self-serve OPB and full custom development — so you never lose a customer to "we need someone to do this for us."

lifecycleFit.heading: The DIFM Layer in Your Website Portfolio
lifecycleFit.intro: DIFM Website Design serves SMBs who need more than a builder but less than a custom WordPress build. It's the managed middle tier that completes your "Get Online" stack.

steps.title: Build a Brand
steps.body: Domains, logo design, and professional email establish the SMB identity before design work begins.

steps.title: Get Online
steps.body: Website Builder for DIY customers, DIFM for hands-off owners, and Custom Website Development for complex needs — a complete "Get Online" tier structure.

steps.title: Get Found
steps.body: SEO, directory listings, and reputation management drive visibility once the site launches.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: Ecommerce, email marketing, and advanced services scale the business on top of a professionally built foundation.

lifecycleFit.positioning: Position DIFM as the managed alternative for SMBs who won't use a DIY builder. Bundle with hosting, SSL, and email for a complete "get online" package. Use it as the bridge between self-serve and custom development.

cta.headline: Ready to Launch Managed Website Design Under Your Brand?
cta.body: Connect with Hostopia to add DIFM Website Design to your portfolio, enable your sales teams with training and scripts, and start delivering professional websites at scale.
